culture.text: Independent engineering consultancy founded in 1975, about 116 staff, headquartered in Rotterdam with five offices and its own acoustics lab.
Staff mostly come from TU Eindhoven, TU Delft and universities of applied sciences, in engineering, physics, architecture and environmental studies.
Its company texts are written in Dutch, a sign Dutch is the everyday working language.
